projects.title: PawCare: Enhancing Veterinary Efficiency and Client Engagement Through Digital Solutions
projects.description: PawCare is a full-stack web-based platform designed to modernize veterinary services. It provides appointment scheduling, secure online payments, and client management. Built with React JS and REST APIs, integrated with PayMongo for payments, and deployed using Vercel and Render.

projects.title: The Adventure Worlds (Godot | Self-Taught)
projects.description: The Adventure Worlds is a self-taught game development project built using Godot Engine. Features include 2D/3D environments, collision detection, physics-based interactions, custom UI, and Blender-created 3D assets. Currently in beta testing.
